worked_solution:
If $A⊆B,$ then $A$ is a subset of $B,$ meaning that every element of $A$ is an element of $B.$

Among the given choices, only $Z⊆N$ is not true. This statement is not true because not every integer is a natural number.  For example, we have $-1\in Z$ but $-1\notin N.$
